info.title: Bake My App Bakery API
info.description:
API behind the bakery owner's panel (Tenant Admin), plus the one public call every bakery app makes
when it starts. So far: sign-in and the person's own account, the bakery's activity log, the setup
checklist, business details, branding (colour, logo, app name, currency symbol), the plan and its
usage, branches (with opening hours and a pause switch), and the app config. Team, menu and payments are added step by step.

**Response format.** The same envelope as every other Bake My App API:
`{ "success": true|false, "message": "...", "data": ... }`. Errors add an `error` list
(`[{ "path": "email", "message": "..." }]`) for field problems.

**Whose data?** Everything under `/v1/tenant` belongs to the bakery of the signed-in person. The
server takes the bakery from the person's token, never from the address or the request body, so
there is no bakery id to send and no way to reach another bakery.

**Signing in.** It works exactly like the staff admin panel but is a separate system with its own
people, tokens and cookie. `POST /v1/tenant/auth/login` returns a short-lived `accessToken` (15
minutes) in the body and sets a `bma_tenant_refresh` cookie. Send the access token on every other
call as `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`. When it expires (a 401), call
`POST /v1/tenant/auth/refresh` once, then retry; if refresh also answers 401, show the sign-in
screen. The cookie is `HttpOnly`: call the API with `credentials: "include"` (fetch) or
`withCredentials: true` (axios). Never run two refreshes at the same time (queue them): using an old
cookie twice ends the session on every device.

**A staff token does not work here, and a bakery token does not work on the admin API.**

**Who can sign in.** Everyone with a bakery account, with a different view for each role. Owners and
managers run the whole bakery. **Branch staff** run the orders of their own branch only. **Riders** see the
deliveries of their own branch and take them out. Branch staff and riders are limited to one branch by the
server (they cannot ask for another), and every other area of the panel answers them 403. `GET /v1/tenant/me`
says which role and branch a person has, and `permissions` says what the screens may offer.

**Browsers.** Only the panel's address (the server's `TENANT_CORS_ORIGINS`) may call `/v1/tenant`
from a browser. `/v1/app/config` is public and any website may call it.

post.description:
Wrong email and wrong password give the same answer. After 5 wrong passwords the account is
locked for 15 minutes (429). A switched-off person, a suspended bakery, or a role with no panel
yet all answer 403 with a message to show. At most 20 attempts per connection per 10 minutes.

200.description: Signed in. The `bma_tenant_refresh` cookie is set.

403.description: The account is switched off, the bakery is suspended, or this role has no panel yet

422.description: Missing or malformed fields

429.description: Too many attempts; the account or the connection is locked for a while

post.description:
Needs the `bma_tenant_refresh` cookie (no body). Returns a new access token and replaces the
cookie. Using a cookie that was already used revokes the whole session (401).

200.description: A new access token; the cookie was replaced

401.description: No valid session. Show the sign-in screen.

post.description: Ends this session and clears the cookie. Always answers 200, even when already signed out.

post.summary: Accept an invitation and choose a password
post.description:
The link in the invitation email is `<TENANT_URL>/accept-invite?token=...`. The panel reads the
token from the address and posts it here. The link works once and expires after 48 hours. The
first invitation of a bakery is the owner's, sent when Bake My App staff create the bakery.
Everyone is signed in straight away, whatever their role: owners and managers, branch staff and
riders. Open the screens that match `user.role`.

201.description: Account created (and signed in, for an owner or manager)

400.description: The link is invalid, already used or expired, or the bakery is suspended

409.description: An account with this email already exists

422.description: Password too weak, or name missing

post.summary: Ask for a password reset link
post.description:
Always answers 200 with the same message, whether or not the address belongs to anyone. If it
does, a link `<TENANT_URL>/reset-password?token=...` is emailed (valid 60 minutes).

post.summary: Choose a new password with the emailed link
post.description: The link works once. All of the person's sessions on every device are ended; they sign in again.

400.description: The link is invalid, already used or expired

422.description: Password too weak

get.description: The signed-in person, their role and permissions, and their bakery.

401.description: Missing, expired or revoked token. Refresh once, then retry.

403.description: The bakery is suspended, or this role has no panel

422.description: Invalid name

post.description:
Signs the person out on every other device and returns a new session for this one (new access
token, new cookie): replace the stored token with the one in the response.

200.description: Password changed; a new session is returned

422.description: Current password wrong, or new password too weak

get.description:
Needs the `audit:view` permission (the owner). Who changed what in this bakery, newest first.
`actor.type` is `user` (someone of the bakery, named), `staff` (always shown as "Bake My App
team"; individual staff are never named) or `system` (nobody was signed in, for example a failed
sign-in). Dates are whole days in Karachi time. Paging: `page` and `limit` (1 to 100, default 10).

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: One or more action names, comma separated

403.description: Your role may not read the activity log

422.description: A filter is invalid

get.description:
Needs `setup:view` (owner and manager). The steps a new bakery works through, in order. Each has
`available` (does that part of the panel exist yet?) and `done`. **Steps that are not available yet
are still listed**, so hide them for now: the day a step is built it flips to `available: true` and the
list needs no change. `route` is a suggested path in your panel. `progress` counts only steps that are
available and required, so optional steps never hold anyone back. `complete` is true only when every
required step exists and is done: while parts of the panel are still being built it stays false.
"Done" for the first two steps means the owner has saved that screen at least once.

403.description: Your role may not see it

get.description: Needs `business:view` (owner and manager). `confirmed` is true once the owner has saved this screen.

403.description: Your role may not see it

patch.description:
Needs `business:edit` (owner). Send only what changes; **an empty body `{}` is allowed and means
"these are right"**: it marks the details as confirmed (ticks the checklist) without changing anything.
`contactEmail` and `contactPhone` can be `null` to clear them. The address name (`slug`), `status`
and anything else not listed is refused (422): the slug is built into the bakery's apps, so only Bake
My App staff can change it. Changing `name` also changes what an app without its own app name shows.
Returns the details as GET does.

403.description: Your role may not change the details

422.description: Invalid value (the `error` list names it), or a field that cannot be sent

get.description:
Needs `branding:view`. The 18 colour presets from the mobile developer's `theme_presets.json`:
the 8 marked `featured` first (show those up front), then the rest. Always read them from here:
presets can be added or recoloured without a release of your panel or of the app.

Needs `branding:view` (owner and manager). `logo` is null until one is uploaded; otherwise its
`url` is public and can be used directly in an `img` tag. `confirmed` is true once the owner has saved
this screen (or uploaded a logo).

403.description: Your role may not see it

patch.description:
Needs `branding:edit` (owner). Send only what changes; `{}` means "these are right" (confirms the
screen). What is saved is exactly what the apps read from `GET /v1/app/config` within a minute.

**Colour.** Following the mobile contract, always save `preset` and `primary` together. Picking a
preset: send its id and its colour, `{ "preset": "violet", "primary": "#903BFF" }` (the colour may be
left out: the server fills it in; a colour that is not the preset's is refused). A custom colour:
`{ "preset": "custom", "primary": "#C15400" }`. `primary` is exactly `#` and 6 hex digits; it is
stored in capitals. A colour sent without `preset` counts as custom.

`appName` is what the app shows inside it (null clears it, and the business name is used); at most 80
characters. `currencySymbol` is shown before every price (for example `Rs` or a dollar sign); at most 8 characters.
Anything else is refused (422). Returns the branding as GET does.

403.description: Your role may not change the branding

422.description: Invalid value (the `error` list names it)

post.description:
Needs `branding:edit` (owner). **The image is the request body itself, not a form**, with its own
type as the Content-Type: `fetch(url, { method: "POST", body: file, headers: { "Content-Type": file.type } })`.
Do not wrap it in `FormData` and do not `JSON.stringify` it.

Allowed: PNG, JPEG, WebP (32 to 4096 pixels on each side, 512 by 512 is ideal) and SVG (up to 200 KB),
at most 2 MB. The server checks what the file really is from its contents, so a renamed file or a wrong
Content-Type is refused. An SVG that contains anything that could run code or load something from
elsewhere (scripts, event handlers, outside links, embedded web content) is refused with the reason,
not cleaned.

A new upload replaces the old logo and gets a new address, so nothing keeps showing the old one.
Uploading counts as saving the branding. Returns the branding as GET does.

403.description: Your role may not change the branding

413.description: The file is larger than 2 MB

415.description: The Content-Type is not one of the four allowed, or no image was sent as the body

422.description: The file is not what it says it is, is too small or too large, or is an unsafe SVG (the `error` list says why: it is safe to show)

delete.description: Needs `branding:edit`. The file is deleted and its address stops working. Removing when there is no logo is fine and answers the same.

200.description: The branding, with `logo` set to null

403.description: Your role may not change the branding

get.description:
Needs `branches:view` (owner and manager). By order (`sortOrder`), then name. Only branches that are
switched on unless you ask for `status=inactive` or `status=all`. Not paged: a bakery has a handful of
branches. Each row has a `status`: `open`, `closed` (outside its hours or a closed day), `paused` (the
owner stopped orders; wins over the hours) or `inactive` (switched off). Open or closed is worked out in
the bakery's own time zone. The list leaves out the hours; the detail has them.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search the name, area or city

403.description: Your role may not see branches

422.description: A filter is invalid

post.description:
Needs `branches:edit` (owner and manager). Only `name`, `addressLine1` and `city` are required. A new branch
takes both delivery and pickup, costs nothing to deliver, has no minimum order, needs 30 minutes to prepare,
goes to the end of the order, and is open 09:00 to 21:00 every day until its hours are changed.

**Money is whole paisa or cents, never a fraction or a string:** a delivery fee of 150.00 is `15000`.

Refused with a 422 whose `error` path is `plan` when the bakery already has as many branches switched on as
its plan allows (Startup 1, Growth 3, Business Suite no limit): show that message. Two active branches of one
bakery cannot share a name (not case sensitive): 422 on `name`. A branch must offer delivery, pickup or both
(422 on `acceptsDelivery`). The bakery, the on/off state and the hours cannot be sent here.

201.description: The new branch, with its hours

403.description: Your role may not add branches

422.description: Invalid field, name already used, or the plan's branch limit is reached (the `error` list says which)

get.description: Needs `branches:view`. The list row plus `hours` (seven days, Monday first). A branch of another bakery is a 404, like any unknown id.

404.description: No such branch in this bakery

patch.description:
Needs `branches:edit`. Send only what changes (at least one field). `phone`, `area` and `addressLine2` can be
`null` to clear them. Sending what is already set changes nothing and is not logged.
`isActive: false` switches the branch off (the same as DELETE); `isActive: true` switches it back on and is
refused (422 on `plan`) when the plan's branch limit is full, or on `name` when another active branch has taken
its name. Pausing is not done here: use the pause call. Returns the branch with its hours.

403.description: Your role may not change branches

404.description: No such branch in this bakery

422.description: Invalid field, name already used, no way to order left, or the plan's branch limit is reached

delete.description:
Needs `branches:edit`. "Deleting" only switches the branch off: it keeps its history, disappears from the
default list (see `status=inactive`) and stops counting against the plan, which frees room for another.
Doing it again changes nothing. It can be switched back on with PATCH.

403.description: Your role may not change branches

404.description: No such branch in this bakery

put.description:
Needs `branches:edit`. **Replaces the whole week**: send all seven days (1 is Monday, 7 is Sunday), in any
order, each once. An open day needs `opensAt` and `closesAt` as `HH:MM` (00:00 to 23:59) with the closing time
after the opening time on the same day: to stay open until midnight use `23:59`. A closed day is
`{ "day": 7, "isClosed": true }` with no times. Field errors name the day, for example `hours.2.closesAt` is
the third entry in what you sent. Only days that really changed are logged. Returns the branch with its hours.

week.summary: A week with a late Friday and a closed Sunday

200.description: The branch with its new hours

403.description: Your role may not change branches

404.description: No such branch in this bakery

422.description: Not seven different days, a bad time, or a closing time that is not after the opening time

post.description:
Needs `branches:edit`. The pause switch: `{ "paused": true }` stops the branch taking orders (a rush, a
power cut) whatever its hours say, `{ "paused": false }` restarts it. Doing what is already done changes
nothing. A switched-off branch cannot be paused (422 on `branch`). Returns the branch.

403.description: Your role may not change branches

404.description: No such branch in this bakery

422.description: The body does not say paused true or paused false, or the branch is switched off

get.description:
For **riders only** (owners, managers and branch staff get 403: they use the orders screens). Needs
`deliveries:manage`. A rider sees only the delivery orders of **their own branch**, never pickup orders and never
another branch's. `view` chooses the list:

- `available` (default): deliveries that are `ready` and that nobody has taken, oldest first. This is the rider's
  job board.
- `mine`: deliveries this rider has taken and not yet handed over, oldest first.
- `done`: deliveries this rider has completed, newest first.

Each row has everything needed on the road: the customer's name and phone, the address with the note for the
rider, and **`amountDue`**: the cash to collect at the door (the whole total for an unpaid cash order, 0
otherwise). The customer's email is never shown to riders. Paging: `page` and `limit` (1 to 100, default 10).

403.description: Only riders use deliveries, or the rider is not assigned to a branch

422.description: A filter is invalid

get.description: For riders only. `available` is how many ready deliveries nobody has taken at the rider's branch, and `mine` how many the rider is carrying now. Use them for badges, and refresh every 15 to 30 seconds.

403.description: Only riders use deliveries

get.description: For riders only. The delivery with its items (names, sizes, quantities, extras and notes) so the rider knows what is in the bag. Only deliveries that are up for grabs at the rider's branch, or that this rider is carrying or has completed, can be opened. Anything else is a 404.

404.description: No such delivery for this rider

post.description:
For riders only. The rider takes a `ready` delivery: it becomes `out_for_delivery` with the rider's name on it,
and the customer is emailed that it is on its way and with whom. **Only one rider can take a delivery.** If two
press at the same moment, one gets 200 and the other gets 404 or 409: show "Someone else took this delivery" and
refresh the list. Taking a delivery you already carry is harmless and answers 200.

200.description: The delivery, now out with the rider

404.description: Not a delivery this rider can take

409.description: Someone else took it, or it is not ready

post.description: For riders only. The rider hands the order to the customer. The order becomes `completed`, and a cash order is marked `paid` because the rider collected the money. Only the rider carrying it can do this. Doing it twice answers 200.

404.description: Not this rider's delivery

409.description: The delivery is not out with this rider

post.description:
For riders only. The rider cannot deliver after all (a breakdown, a wrong address). The order goes back to
`ready` and is up for grabs again, with the rider's `reason` (3 to 200 characters, required) in the order's story
so the bakery can see what happened. The customer is not emailed. Only the rider carrying it can do this.

404.description: Not this rider's delivery

409.description: The delivery is not out with this rider

422.description: A reason is missing

get.description:
Needs `orders:view` (owner, manager and branch staff). Branch staff only ever see the orders of their own branch
(they cannot ask for another: `branchId` is ignored for them, and another branch's order is a 404). The orders customers placed at this bakery, newest first, as summaries
for the board (no lines: open one for those). Filters: `status` (one or more, comma separated, from `placed`,
`accepted`, `preparing`, `ready`, `out_for_delivery`, `completed`, `cancelled`, or the words `active` for
everything not finished and `past` for completed and cancelled), `branchId`, `fulfilment` (`delivery` or
`pickup`), `paymentMethod` (`cod` or `card`), `q` (an order number, or part of the customer's name or phone),
`from` and `to` (`YYYY-MM-DD`, Karachi days, by when it was placed) and `sort` (`newest` default, or `oldest`
which suits a kitchen queue). Paging: `page` and `limit` (1 to 100, default 10).

A card order only appears once the customer has really paid: orders waiting for payment, or closed unpaid, are never listed. Each row has `nextStatuses`: where the order can go from here. Show buttons only for those.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: One or more statuses, comma separated, or active or past

parameters.name: paymentStatus
parameters.description: Use refund_failed to find cancelled card orders the owner must refund by hand

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Order number, or part of the customer name or phone

403.description: Your role may not see orders

422.description: A filter is invalid

get.description:
Needs `orders:view`. How many orders are at each unfinished stage right now (`placed`, `accepted`, `preparing`,
`ready`, `out_for_delivery`) and the total as `active`. Use it for the badges on the board and the menu, and
refresh it every 15 to 30 seconds. `branchId` limits it to one branch. `placed` is the number of orders nobody
has accepted yet: that is the one to make noticeable.

403.description: Your role may not see orders

422.description: Not a valid branch id

get.description:
Needs `orders:view`. The summary plus everything needed to prepare and hand over the order: the customer's name,
phone and email, the delivery address with the rider's note, the customer's order note, every line with its size,
extras and note, and `events`, the order's story (who moved it, when, and the reason for a cancellation). An order
of another bakery is a 404, like any unknown id.

403.description: Your role may not see orders

404.description: No such order in this bakery

post.summary: Move an order along, or cancel it
post.description:
Needs `orders:manage` (owner and manager). Send the `status` to move to. The path is
`placed` to `accepted` to `preparing` to `ready`, then for **delivery** `out_for_delivery` and `completed`, or
for **pickup** straight to `completed`. An order can be cancelled from any stage before it is finished. Skipping
a stage, going back, or changing a finished order is a 422 on `status`: use `nextStatuses` from the order.

- **Cancelling needs a `reason`** (3 to 200 characters). The customer is shown it and emailed it. A reason is
  refused for any other status.
- When **sending a delivery out**, `riderId` can name the rider taking it (one of the branch's active riders:
  422 on `riderId` otherwise). The customer is emailed who is bringing it. Riders can also take a ready
  delivery themselves from their own screens.
- When **accepting**, `readyInMinutes` (1 to 720) sets how long until it is ready, if that differs from the
  branch's usual preparation time. It is refused for other statuses.
- Completing a **cash on delivery** order marks it `paid`: the cash has been collected.
- Asking for the status the order already has changes nothing and answers 200, so a retry is harmless.
- The change is made only if the order is still where you saw it. If a colleague or the customer changed it a
  moment ago the answer is **409** (or a 422 on `status` when it can no longer go there): refresh the order and
  show what happened.

The customer is emailed when the order is accepted, ready for pickup, out for delivery and cancelled. A
customer can only cancel their own order while it is still `placed`.

value.reason: We ran out of cocoa today, sorry

403.description: Your role may not change orders

404.description: No such order in this bakery

409.description: Someone else changed the order a moment ago

422.description: The order cannot go to that status, a reason is missing or not allowed, or an invalid field

get.description:
Needs `payments:manage` (**owner only**: hide the screen from managers). How customers can pay this bakery.
Cash on delivery (`cod`) and cards (`card`, through the bakery's **own** Stripe account: the money never
passes through Bake My App). `card.configured` says keys are saved; `card.ready` says the saved key passed its
last test with Stripe, which is needed before cards can be switched on. `usable` is true when customers have at
least one way to pay. **The secret key is never returned**, only `card.secretKeyHint` such as `sk_test_����1234`.
A new bakery has nothing switched on.

403.description: Only the owner may see payment settings

patch.description:
Needs `payments:manage`. Send only what changes: `codEnabled`, `codNote` (a line shown to customers, `null`
clears it) and `cardEnabled`. Switching cards on is refused (422 on `cardEnabled`) until a Stripe key has been
saved and passed its test. Switching both off is refused (422 on `codEnabled`): keep at least one way to pay.
Saving counts as confirming the choice, which ticks the setup checklist (an empty body confirms what is
already chosen, if something is). Sending what is already set changes nothing and is not logged.

403.description: Only the owner may change payment settings

422.description: Invalid field, cards without working keys, or nothing left switched on

put.description:
Needs `payments:manage`. The owner pastes the two keys from their own Stripe dashboard
(Developers, API keys). The **secret key is checked with Stripe first** and only saved if Stripe accepts it;
it is then stored locked and **never shown again** (not in any answer, log or activity entry). Both keys
must be for the same mode: `pk_test_` with `sk_test_`, or `pk_live_` with `sk_live_`. The answer's `card.mode`
says which. Saved keys replace the old ones. Cards stay off until switched on with PATCH.
Errors: 422 on `secretKey` (not shaped like a Stripe secret key, or Stripe did not accept it) or
`publishableKey`; 503 when Stripe cannot be reached (try again) or when the server has no key to lock
secrets with (contact Bake My App). Never put the secret key in a URL or keep it in the panel after saving.
Limited to 20 tries per 10 minutes.

200.description: Saved. The settings, with a hint of the key

403.description: Only the owner may save payment keys

422.description: Keys are malformed, do not match, or Stripe did not accept the secret key

503.description: Stripe could not be reached, or card payments cannot be saved on this server

delete.description:
Needs `payments:manage`. Forgets both keys and switches cards off. Cash on delivery is not touched.
Refused (422 on `codEnabled`) while cards are on and cash is off, so customers are never left with no way to
pay. Removing keys that are not there is fine.

403.description: Only the owner may remove payment keys

422.description: Cards are the only way to pay right now

post.description:
Needs `payments:manage`. Asks Stripe again whether the saved secret key still works. A 200 is returned either
way: `ok: true` means Stripe accepted it; `ok: false` means Stripe no longer does (the owner rolled or deleted
the key), and then **cards are switched off at once** so customers are never offered a payment that cannot
go through. The owner must save a working key and switch cards on again. A 422 means no keys are saved yet; a
503 means Stripe could not be reached and nothing was changed. Limited to 20 tries per 10 minutes.

200.description: The result of the test, with the settings

403.description: Only the owner may test payment keys

422.description: No keys are saved

get.description:
Needs `menu:view` (owner and manager). The sections of the menu in their order, each with
`productCount` (products that are switched on). Only categories that are switched on unless you ask for
`status=inactive` or `status=all`. Not paged.

422.description: A filter is invalid

post.description:
Needs `menu:edit` (owner and manager). Goes to the end of the order. Two categories that are switched on
cannot share a name (not case sensitive): 422 on `name`. The bakery cannot be sent.

422.description: Invalid field or the name is taken

put.description:
Needs `menu:edit`. Send the category ids in the order they should appear. Ones you leave out follow
after, in their old order. Any id that is not one of this bakery's categories, a repeat, or an empty list
is a 422. Returns the categories that are switched on.

200.description: The categories in their new order

422.description: Not a list of this bakery's categories

get.description: Needs `menu:view`. A category of another bakery is a 404, like any unknown id.

404.description: No such category in this bakery

patch.description:
Needs `menu:edit`. Send only what changes (at least one field). `description` can be `null` to clear it.
Sending what is already set changes nothing and is not logged. `isActive: false` switches the category off
(the same as DELETE); `true` brings it back, and is refused (422 on `isActive`) when another category
has taken its name meanwhile.

404.description: No such category in this bakery

422.description: Invalid field or the name is taken

delete.description: Needs `menu:edit`. "Deleting" only switches it off, so its products are kept and it can be switched on again with PATCH. Customers will not see its products. Doing it again changes nothing.

404.description: No such category in this bakery

get.description:
Needs `menu:view`. Groups of extras such as "Toppings", each with its options and `productCount`
(how many products offer it). Only groups that are switched on unless you ask for `status=inactive` or
`status=all`.

post.description:
Needs `menu:edit`. `minSelect` is how many the customer must pick (0 means optional) and `maxSelect` how
many at most (`null` means any number). A group cannot ask for more picks than it has options (422 on
`minSelect`), and the most cannot be below the fewest (422 on `maxSelect`). **Option prices are whole paisa
or cents** and are charged on top of the product: free extras are `0`. Option names are unique within the
group. Group names are unique among those switched on (422 on `name`).

422.description: Invalid field, name taken, or the pick limits do not fit the options

get.description: Needs `menu:view`. A group of another bakery is a 404.

404.description: No such group in this bakery

patch.description:
Needs `menu:edit`. Send only what changes: `name`, `minSelect`, `maxSelect` (`null` for no limit) or
`isActive`. Options are changed with their own call. Same pick rules as when adding. A group that is off
cannot be given to a product, and switching it back on is refused when another group took its name.

404.description: No such group in this bakery

422.description: Invalid field, name taken, or the pick limits do not fit

delete.description: Needs `menu:edit`. Only switches it off; it can be switched on again with PATCH.

404.description: No such group in this bakery

put.summary: Set the options of a group
put.description:
Needs `menu:edit`. Replaces the whole list, in the order sent. An option sent with its `id` is kept and
edited; one without an `id` is new; any existing option not sent is removed. `isAvailable: false` marks an
option sold out without removing it. Names must be different within the group, an `id` must belong to this
group, and a group cannot be left with fewer options than customers must pick. At most 50 options.
Sending exactly what is already there changes nothing and is not logged.

200.description: The group with its new options

404.description: No such group in this bakery

422.description: Invalid option, repeated name, or an id that is not in this group

get.description:
Needs `menu:view`. In menu order: by category, then product. Filters: `q` (name), `categoryId`, `status`
(`active` default, `inactive` or `all`) and `branchId` (only what that branch sells). Paging: `page` and
`limit` (1 to 100, default 10). `price` is the single price or `null` when sizes carry the prices;
`priceFrom` is what to show as "from" (the price, or the lowest size). All money is in paisa or cents.

422.description: A filter is invalid

post.description:
Needs `menu:edit`. Needs `categoryId` (one of your categories that is switched on) and `name`, and
**either `price` or `sizes`, not both**: a product with sizes has a price on each size. **Money is whole
paisa or cents, never a fraction or a string**: 2,500.00 is `250000`, and a price must be at least 1. At
most 10 sizes with different names. A product name is used once per category among those switched on
(422 on `name`). The photo, add-on groups and branches are set with their own calls. Returns the full
product.

422.description: Invalid field, price rules broken, category not usable, or the name is taken

put.summary: Put a category's products in order
put.description:
Needs `menu:edit`. Send the `categoryId` and the product ids of that category in the order they should
appear. Ones left out follow after. An id from another category or bakery, a repeat, or an empty list is a
422. Returns the category's products that are switched on.

200.description: The products in their new order

422.description: Not products of this category

get.description: Needs `menu:view`. The list row plus `sizes`, `addonSets` (with their options) and `branches` (every branch that is switched on, and whether it sells this product). A product of another bakery is a 404.

404.description: No such product in this bakery

patch.description:
Needs `menu:edit`. Send only what changes (at least one field): `name`, `description` (`null` clears it),
`categoryId` (moves it to the end of that category), `price` or `isActive`. A product that has sizes takes
no `price` here (422): change its sizes instead. Sending what is already set changes nothing and is not
logged. `isActive: false` switches the product off (the same as DELETE); `true` brings it back, refused
while its category is off or when the name is taken in the category.

404.description: No such product in this bakery

422.description: Invalid field, name taken, or not allowed for this product

delete.description: Needs `menu:edit`. Only switches it off, so it keeps its history and customers stop seeing it. It can be switched on again with PATCH.

404.description: No such product in this bakery

put.summary: Set the sizes of a product
put.description:
Needs `menu:edit`. Replaces the whole list, in the order sent. A size sent with its `id` is kept (and
edited), one without is new, and any not sent is removed. With sizes the product's own price is cleared;
**to go back to no sizes send `sizes: []` and a `price`**. Sending sizes together with a `price`, or an
empty list without one, is a 422. At most 10 sizes, different names, prices at least 1.

404.description: No such product in this bakery

422.description: Invalid sizes or price rules broken

put.summary: Choose the add-on groups of a product
put.description:
Needs `menu:edit`. The groups this product offers, in the order sent (up to 10, each once). Every id must
be one of your add-on groups that is switched on (422 on `addonSetIds`). Send `[]` to offer none.

404.description: No such product in this bakery

422.description: Not add-on groups of this bakery

put.summary: Say which branches do not sell a product
put.description:
Needs `menu:edit`. Every branch sells every product unless named here, so a new branch sells everything
and the list of exceptions stays short. Send the branch ids that do **not** sell it (`[]` for none). Every
id must be one of your branches (422 on `unavailableBranchIds`). The product's `branches` list shows the
result for each branch that is switched on.

404.description: No such product in this bakery

422.description: Not branches of this bakery

post.description:
Needs `menu:edit`. **The picture is the request body itself, not a form**, with its own type as the
Content-Type: `fetch(url, { method: "POST", body: file, headers: { "Content-Type": file.type } })`.
Allowed: PNG, JPEG or WebP, 200 to 4096 pixels on each side, at most 5 MB. SVG is not allowed for photos.
The server checks what the file really is, so a renamed file or a wrong Content-Type is refused.
A new upload replaces the old photo and gets a new address. The photo's `url` is public and cacheable.
Returns the product.

404.description: No such product in this bakery

413.description: The file is larger than 5 MB

415.description: Not sent as the request body with an image Content-Type

422.description: Not a real picture, or the wrong size

delete.description: Needs `menu:edit`. Removing a photo that is not there is fine.

404.description: No such product in this bakery

get.description:
Needs `team:view` (owner and manager). The people of this bakery, by name. Filters: `q` (name or email),
`role`, `branchId`, `status` (`active` or `inactive`). Paging: `page` and `limit` (1 to 100, default 10).
`canSignIn` is true for every built-in role: branch staff and riders have their own screens. `isLocked` is true while too many wrong passwords keep someone out.

403.description: Your role may not see the team

422.description: A filter is invalid

get.description:
Needs `team:view`. The four bakery roles with what each may do, whether it needs a branch
(`requiresBranch`) and whether the signed-in person may give it out (`assignable`: managers cannot
give out the owner role). Use it to fill the role picker.

Needs `team:view`. Invitations nobody has accepted yet, newest first. Expired ones are listed with
`expired: true` so they can be sent again. `invitedBy.type` is `user` (named) or `staff`
(always shown as "Bake My App team").

post.description:
Needs `team:manage` (owner and manager). Emails a one-time link to choose a password. Branch staff and
riders need a `branchId` (one of your branches that is switched on); owners and managers must not have
one. Only an owner can invite an owner. Inviting an address again replaces the earlier link.
An address already on your team is refused with a 422 on `email`. An address that belongs to someone at
another bakery gets a general "cannot be used" message that does not say why. If the email cannot be
sent the invitation is not kept and you get a 503: try again.

403.description: Your role may not invite, or only an owner may invite an owner

422.description: Invalid field, role or branch, or the address cannot be used (the `error` list says which)

503.description: The email could not be sent

delete.description: Needs `team:manage`. The link stops working at once. Only an owner can cancel an owner invitation. Another bakery's invitation is a 404.

403.description: Only an owner may cancel an owner invitation

404.description: No such invitation in this bakery

get.description:
Needs `team:view`. The list row plus `permissions`, `activeSessions` (devices signed in now),
`lockedUntil` and the last 20 things they did (`recentActivity`). A person of another bakery is a 404.

404.description: No such person in this bakery

patch.description:
Needs `team:manage`. Send only what changes (at least one field): `name`, `role`, `branchId` or
`isActive`. Sending what is already set changes nothing and is not logged. Changing to a role that
works across all branches clears the branch. `isActive: false` switches the person off and signs them
out everywhere at once; `true` brings them back and clears any lock.

Rules that keep a bakery from locking itself out: nobody changes their own role or switches
themselves off (422); a manager cannot change an owner or make anyone an owner (403); a bakery
always keeps at least one active owner (422). Email and bakery cannot be sent.

403.description: Your role may not change this person

404.description: No such person in this bakery

422.description: Invalid field, own role or account, role and branch do not fit, or the last owner

post.description: Needs `team:manage`. Every device is signed out and every token stops working. The person can sign in again. Only an owner can do this to an owner.

200.description: The person, now with no sessions

403.description: Only an owner may do this to an owner

404.description: No such person in this bakery

post.description: Needs `team:manage`. Lifts the lock that too many wrong passwords cause, so the person can try again at once.

403.description: Only an owner may do this to an owner

404.description: No such person in this bakery

get.description:
Needs `plan:view` (owner). Read only: what plan the bakery is on, what it costs, when it renews, and
how much of it is used. Stripe ids and links never appear here; changing the plan or the card is done by
Bake My App staff for now. `price.amount` is in cents (`29900` is 299.00) and is `null` for a plan sold by
quote. `usage.branches.limit` is `null` when the plan has no limit. `paymentProblem` is true while a payment
is failing and being retried: show a notice. `status` is `trial`, `active`, `past_due`, `suspended`, `paused`
or `cancelled`.

403.description: Your role may not see the plan

get.description:
The address of a logo (the `logo.url` in the branding). No token: anyone with the address can show
it, from any website (`img`, CSS, or a canvas). Every upload has its own address that never changes
its content, so it is cached for a year (`immutable`). Served so it can be shown but never run: with
`nosniff`, a sandboxing policy and permission to be embedded cross-origin.

404.description: No such file (or it was replaced or removed)

get.description:
The call a bakery's mobile app makes on every start, before anyone signs in, and the web
storefront makes on load. No token. Name the bakery with the `X-Tenant` header (its slug); a web
page that cannot send custom headers may use `?tenant=<slug>` instead (the header wins when both
are present). The slug is built into each bakery's app build.

The answer is cached for a minute (`Cache-Control: public, max-age=60`, `Vary: X-Tenant`), so a
colour change shows within a minute and the next time the app opens. The app must wait at most 4
seconds; if the call fails or the bakery is unknown (404, also for a suspended bakery) the app keeps
its last config or its defaults and never crashes. A bakery still being set up already answers, so
the app can be tested early. Any website may call it from a browser (no cookies are involved).

The app builds every other shade from `theme.primary` by itself. `theme.preset` is the id of one
of the 18 presets, or `custom`.

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description: The slug again, for callers that cannot send a header

404.description: Unknown, malformed or suspended bakery. Keep the defaults.

get.description: Needs `payments:manage` (owner only). Tax and whether discounts add up, and whether customers may order without an account.

patch.summary: Change how prices are worked out
patch.description: Send only what changes. An empty body is fine.

taxRate.description: A percentage of the goods after discounts. 0 is no tax

pricesIncludeTax.description: true: the prices already contain the tax (it is only shown). false: tax is added on top

discountsStack.description: true: a quantity discount and a promo code both apply. false: only the better one

guestCheckoutEnabled.description: false: customers must sign in before ordering

get.description: Needs `payments:manage`. `status` is active, inactive or all. `uses` counts live orders (a cancelled order gives its use back).

post.description: `type` percent (value 1 to 100) or fixed (value in paisa or cents). A code is unique within the bakery (422 promo_code_taken).

404.description: Not found

patch.description: The code itself cannot be renamed (make a new one). isActive false switches it off.

delete.description: Used codes are kept for the record, so this only deactivates it.

get.description: Needs `menu:view`. Filter with `productId` or `categoryId`. A product's own steps win over its category's; the best step the quantity reaches applies to the whole line.

post.description: Needs `menu:edit`. Exactly one of `productId` and `categoryId`.

patch.summary: Change or switch off a step

get.description: Needs `payments:manage` (owner only). Both are off until the owner switches them on and sets the rates.

patch.summary: Change the wallet and points rules

pointsPerMajorUnit.description: Points earned for every 1.00 of goods, for example 0.01 for one point per Rs 100

pointsValueMinor.description: What one point is worth in the wallet, paisa or cents (100 means Rs 1)

streakBonusPoints.description: Bonus for ordering in a second week in a row, and every week after, once a week

post.summary: Put money in a customer's wallet
post.description: A goodwill gesture or a refund paid another way. 422 wallet_unavailable until the wallet is switched on. Written to the activity log.

reason.description: Shown to the customer in their wallet history

200.description: Done, with the customer's new balance

404.description: Not this bakery's customer

get.description: Owner and managers only. Includes switched-off questions.
`status` open, closed or all; `type` refund_status, missing_points or order_feedback. Each has the customer, the order, the message and an optional picture.

404.description: Not found

post.summary: Answer a request and close it
post.description: One answer per request. Answering again is 422 ticket_closed.

422.description: Already answered

get.description: Most recent conversation first. `needsReply` is true when the customer wrote last.
Event `ready` first, then an event `message` for each new message from any customer. Events are passed along inside one server: also reload the list when it opens and when the stream drops.
Oldest first; `after` (a message id) returns only newer messages.

404.description: Not this bakery's customer

get.description: Owner and managers only (branch staff and riders get 403). Today against yesterday (a sale is an order that was really placed and not cancelled; a card order that was never paid is not an order), what the kitchen has on right now, customer counts, open requests and chats waiting for an answer, the last seven days (every day listed, quiet ones with zeros), the five best sellers this week and the five newest orders. Money is whole paisa or cents. ordersChange and salesChange are whole percents against yesterday, null when yesterday had none.

Owner and managers only. People with an account at this bakery (guests have none). orders and spent count real orders that were not cancelled. q searches name, email and phone. sort is recent (default), orders, spent or name.
Totals, average order, cancelled orders, saved addresses, favourites, the items they order most, wallet and points balances, and their ten latest orders. 404 for a customer of another bakery.

404.description: Not this bakery's customer

get.description: Owner and managers only. Everything is for the days from to to (at most 366 days, in the bakery's time zone), optionally for one branch. totals compares with the same number of days just before (ordersChange and salesChange, whole percents, null when that period had none). series is the sales chart grouped by day, week or month (a week or month is named by its first day). byStatus counts every real order including cancelled ones; the rest count sales only. customers splits buyers with an account into new (their first order ever is in these days) and returning, and counts guest orders. promos lists each promo code used in these days with its uses, the discount it gave and the sales it was on. busiestHours counts orders by hour of the day (0 to 23). 422 range_invalid or range_too_long for a bad range. Limited to 30 a minute.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD, in the bakery's time zone. Default is 29 days before the end date

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day, included. Default is today

404.description: Not this bakery's branch

422.description: A bad date range

get.description: The whole Store information section in one answer: business details (name, contact, time zone, currency), the look (app name, currency symbol, colour preset and primary colour) and the logo. Needs business:view and branding:view (owner and managers). The older /business and /branding screens still work and show the same data.

patch.description: Send any of the business and brand fields together; only what is sent changes, and an empty body just confirms. The colour is checked before anything is saved, so a bad colour leaves the business details unchanged. The slug, status and subscription cannot be sent (422). Needs business:edit and branding:edit (owner only). The logo is a picture, so it has its own call: POST /store/logo.

address.description: The bakery's address as one line

preset.description: A colour preset id, or custom

primary.description: #RRGGBB. With a preset it must be that preset's own colour

403.description: Only the owner can change the store

422.description: A bad field or colour

post.description: The picture is the request body itself (not a form), with its own Content-Type: image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp or image/svg+xml, up to 2 MB. fetch(url, { method: 'POST', body: file, headers: { 'Content-Type': file.type } }). The answer is the whole store, with the new logo address. Needs business:edit and branding:edit.

415.description: Not a picture type we take

422.description: Not really a picture

delete.description: Removing a logo that is not there is fine. The answer is the whole store.

get.description: Needs branches:view. branches lists every branch with its own week (days 1 Monday to 7 Sunday, times HH:MM, a closed day has null times). sameForAll is true when every active branch has the same week, and then hours is that week: show one week to edit. A branch can still differ, and per-branch hours stay at PUT /branches/{id}/hours.

put.description: Needs branches:edit (owner and managers). Sends one whole week (all seven days) and applies it to the branches in branchIds, or to every active branch when branchIds is left out. Each branch change is written to the activity log. 422 for a week that does not add up (closing before opening, a day twice), and branch_invalid for a branch of another bakery.

closesAt.description: Use 23:59 to stay open until midnight

422.description: A bad week

get.description: The Order settings section in one answer. Owner only (payments:manage). acceptDelivery and acceptPickup are bakery-wide switches that apply on top of each branch's own. deliveryMinutes is a typical delivery time (null until set). minimumOrder (paisa or cents) and deliveryRadiusKm (kilometres, null means no limit) belong to branches, so they are one value when every branch has the same and null when they differ: branchesDiffer says which. taxRate and taxLabel are the bakery's tax.

patch.description: Send any of the fields; only what is sent changes. minimumOrder and deliveryRadiusKm are set on every branch of the bakery at once (a branch can still be changed on its own afterwards under /branches). Turning acceptDelivery or acceptPickup off makes customers' quotes and orders for that kind answer 422 delivery_paused or pickup_paused. taxLabel is one of Tax, VAT, Sales Tax, GST, Service Tax; an order keeps the label it was placed with. The radius is in kilometres: a panel that shows miles converts (1 mile is 1.609344 km). Written to the activity log.

minimumOrder.description: Paisa or cents, on every branch

403.description: Only the owner can change order settings

422.description: A bad value

get.description: The signed-in person's own choices (everyone who can sign in to the panel has them; nobody can see or change another person's): newOrderAlerts, orderStatusUpdates, lowStockWarnings, dailySalesSummary, weeklyAnalyticsReport, customerReviews. Until a person chooses, they are true, true, true, false, true, true. The panel reads them to decide on chimes and alerts. They are stored for you; emails for the daily and weekly summaries are not sent yet.

patch.description: Send any of the six as true or false; the rest keep their value.

422.description: Not true or false

branchId.description: The branch a branch staff member or rider works at. Empty for owners and managers

permissions.description: What this role may do; `*` means everything a bakery has

accessToken.description: Null only for a role that has no panel access (none of the built-in roles)

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the access token expires

panelAccess.description: Only present, and false, when a role has no panel access (none of the built-in roles)

changes.description: What changed, for example { name: { from, to } }

key.description: business, branding, branch, menu, payments or team

available.description: Does that part of the panel exist yet? Hide the step when false

complete.description: True only when every required step exists and is done

status.description: Worked out now, in the bakery's time zone. paused wins over the hours

paymentStatus.description: refund_failed is a cancelled card order whose refund did not go through: refund it by hand in Stripe

amountDue.description: Cash to collect at the door: the total for an unpaid cash order, else 0

available.description: Ready deliveries nobody has taken, at the rider's branch

items.description: Only in the detail and after taking, handing over or handing back

number.description: The bakery's own running number, as the customer knows it

paymentStatus.description: refund_failed is a cancelled card order whose refund did not go through: refund it by hand in Stripe

rider.description: Who is taking a delivery out, once one is

nextStatuses.description: Where the order can go from here. Show buttons only for these

placed.description: Waiting for the bakery to accept

refundsNeeded.description: Cancelled card orders whose refund failed: the owner must refund them by hand

id.description: Empty once the customer deleted their account

notes.description: The customer's note for the whole order

reference.description: A card order's payment id in the bakery's own Stripe dashboard

note.description: A line shown to customers who pay in cash

verifiedAt.description: When the key last passed a test with Stripe

ready.description: The saved key passed its last test, so cards can be switched on

usable.description: Customers have at least one way to pay

price.description: Extra cost in paisa or cents; 0 is free

minSelect.description: How many the customer must pick

maxSelect.description: How many at most; null for any number

price.description: Paisa or cents; null when sizes carry the prices

priceFrom.description: The price, or the lowest size: show as from

branches.description: Every branch that is switched on

available.description: Whether this branch sells the product

canSignIn.description: True for every built-in role; false only if a role has no panel access

assignable.description: Whether the signed-in person may give this role out

app_name.description: The name shown inside the app

logo_url.description: The bakery's logo (PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG, up to 2 MB as uploaded), or null until the owner uploads one. The address changes when a new logo is uploaded, so cache by address

min_app_version.description: The oldest app version that may still be used, for example 2.1.0, or null when there is no minimum. If the installed version is older, show an update screen

support_phone.description: The bakery's phone from its Business screen, or null until the owner fills it in

support_email.description: The bakery's contact email from its Business screen, or null

currency_code.description: ISO 4217 code of the bakery's currency. Amounts are always whole hundredths of it

timezone.description: The bakery's IANA time zone, which its branch hours and open or closed status use

accepting_orders.description: True only while the bakery is live. False while it is still being set up: show a coming-soon state instead of a checkout that would be refused

features.description: What this bakery can do right now, so the app shows only screens that work. Always on: coordinates, delivery_radius, promo_codes, rider_tracking, help, live_chat. Chosen by the owner: guest_checkout, wallet, points. Not built yet (always false): push_notifications, notification_inbox

deliveryRadiusKm.description: Null for no limit, or when the branches differ
